summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16) disclosing the resignation of Chief Financial Officer and Joint Company Secretary Phillip Hains, effective immediately. The company appointed Mr Aaron Laurita as CFO and Ms Amritha Sushil as Joint Company Secretary, both nominees of Acclime Australia under a continuing services agreement. Mr Nathan Jong remains Joint Company Secretary. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics were stated because this is a routine management change. The event is a personnel transition, not a special situation transaction. What to watch: future operational updates under the new CFO.
